verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state users can manually add, edit, or delete memories via Settings > Personalization > Memory, and that the memory system persists facts across conversations; Open WebUI is also documented as self-hosted/offline-capable (including air-gapped deployments), meaning the memory store lives on the user's own infrastructure rather than a vendor cloud. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the underlying storage format/schema (e.g., database file location, export format) confirming it as an 'open format', and independent/hands-on confirmation of the edit/delete workflow.
